import json,os,re,subprocess,sys

import json,os,re,subprocess,sys
src,build=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
env=dict(os.environ); env['LC_ALL']='C'
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']=os.path.join(build,'target')

tmp=os.path.join(build,'tmp'); os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True)
env['TMPDIR']=tmp
env.pop('MG_EVIDENCE_DIR',None)
r=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','--offline','--locked','--test','verify_pack','--','--nocapture'],
                 cwd=src,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
out=(r.stdout+r.stderr).decode('utf-8','replace')
import glob
paths=[l.split("-> ",1)[1].strip() for l in out.splitlines() if "[v9] evidence ->" in l]
dirs=sorted({os.path.dirname(x) for x in paths})
d=dirs[0] if dirs else None
files=sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d,'v9-*.txt'))) if d else []
in_tmp = bool(d) and os.path.realpath(d).startswith(os.path.realpath(tmp)+os.sep)
no_repo_write = not os.path.exists(os.path.join(src,'.orch'))
print('reported v9 lines:',len(paths),'| distinct dirs:',len(dirs))
print('default evidence dir:',d)
print('under TMPDIR:',in_tmp,'| files:',len(files))
for f in files[:12]: print('   ',os.path.basename(f),'->',os.path.getsize(f))
print('repo copy has NO .orch/:',no_repo_write)
ok = r.returncode==0 and in_tmp and len(paths)>=10 and len(files)>=10 and no_repo_write
print('VERDICT','PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import json,os,re,subprocess,sys
src,build=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
env=dict(os.environ); env['LC_ALL']='C'
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']=os.path.join(build,'target')

tmp=os.path.join(build,'tmp'); os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True)
env['TMPDIR']=tmp
custom=os.path.join(build,'ev'); env['MG_EVIDENCE_DIR']=custom
r=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','--offline','--locked','--test','verify_pack','--','--nocapture'],
                 cwd=src,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
out=(r.stdout+r.stderr).decode('utf-8','replace')
import glob
paths=[l.split("-> ",1)[1].strip() for l in out.splitlines() if "[v9] evidence ->" in l]
dirs=sorted({os.path.dirname(x) for x in paths})
d=dirs[0] if dirs else None
files=sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(custom,'v9-*.txt')))
honored = bool(d) and os.path.realpath(d)==os.path.realpath(custom)
print('reported v9 lines:',len(paths),'| distinct dirs:',len(dirs))
print('override path:',d,'| MG_EVIDENCE_DIR honored:',honored,'| files:',len(files))
print('total bytes:',sum(os.path.getsize(f) for f in files) if files else 0)
for f in files[:12]: print('   ',os.path.basename(f),'->',os.path.getsize(f))
print('repo copy has NO .orch/:',not os.path.exists(os.path.join(src,'.orch')))
ok = r.returncode==0 and honored and len(paths)>=10 and len(files)>=10 and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(src,'.orch'))
print('VERDICT','PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
